fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of the bug request; no owner was present and no question was put to the arbiter. Research: the incident transcripts (e.g. quality check dbb3e57f) end in Claude Code's synthetic API-error line (isApiErrorMessage, model <synthetic>, text 'Please run /login · API Error: 403 Attention Required! | Cloudflare'), the same line shape the claudecode adapter's UsageLimit already reads. `rhiza session run` already polls each run session's transcript every 30s (watchLimit, internal/api/session_run.go) for the usage limit. The watchdog's agentNudge (20m) and session.Stalled cover a silent session; the incident's sessions sat idle about 18 minutes, under that cutoff. session.message types only into an idle session and waits on a blocked one. Planned: the adapter reads a transient API error; session run re-prompts an autonomous run's session after it with backoff and, when retries run out (or at once in an owner-attended run), records it so the inbox lists an api-error item. The transcript-silence clause stays with the existing watchdog.
fields.title: Plan: re-prompt run sessions stopped on an API error (autonomous plan run)
